texts.preamble: Food Safety Officer'S Association vs Union Of India And Others on 18 April, 2012 Cwp No.6948 of 2012 -1- In The High Court Of Punjab And Haryana At Chandigarh Cwp No.6948 of 2012 Date of decision : 18.04.2012 Food Safety Officer's Association, Jalandhar ...... Petitioner vs. Union of India and others ...... Respondents * ** Coram : Hon'Ble Mr.Justice Ajay Tewari *** Present : Mr. Rajiv Atma Ram, Sr. Advocate with Mr. Arjun Pratap Atma Ram, Advocate for the petitioner.
texts.arguments: The grievance raised in this petition is that members of the petitioner-Food Safety Officer's Association were working as Food Inspectors under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 which has now been substituted as Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (hereinafter referred to as 'the Act') and they have now re-designated as Food Safety Inspectors under the new Act. As per the learned senior counsel they are fully eligible to be appointed as Designated Officers and, in fact some of the members of the petitioner-Association have been nominated by the State and imparted training. Further as per the learned senior counsel an employee can be appointed as whole time Designated Officer under the Act. The post of Designated Officer is a whole time job but now the Food Safety Officer'S Association vs Union Of India And Others on 18 April, 2012 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/181439402/ 1 Government has appointed such officers as Designated Officers who by virtue of the office they hold can only work on the post of Designated Officer on part time basis in addition to the other multi-farious charges being given to them. Learned senior counsel states that in this regard the petitioner- Association has also moved a representation (Annexure P-10) and that at this stage he would be satisfied if the said representation is decided by respondent No.3 by passing a speaking order within any reasonable time.
